Cucumbers.note: Currency id and save key stay 'Cucumbers'; displayed leaderstat renamed 'Cukes' 2026-07-30 (CurrencyHandler.lua:22-28). Stored as NumberValue (double) - no cap, precision loss past 2^53 (InstanceValues.lua:38).

Coins.note: NumberValue (double), no cap (InstanceValues.lua:33). Sell vendor converts Cukes->Coins 1:1 pre-multiplier (SellVendorServer.lua:78-81).

BossShards.note: Not a leaderstat; per-zone counters in profile.BossShards, 10 forge that zone's boss pet (BreakablesService.lua:1026-1045). Spent on forge.

Orbs.note: Legacy name only - code variable 'Orbs' points at the Cukes leaderstat; Leaderboards__Orbs.lua is the cucumber leaderboard.

addCurrency.signature: AddCurrency({Player, Currency, Amount, HasTotal, WasPurchase, MultipliersApplied, Hide}) -> finalAmount (line 105-179)
addCurrency.multiplierFunction: GetMulipliers (typo is canonical) line 66-103; skipped entirely when WasPurchase OR MultipliersApplied (line 72)

flagSemantics.WasPurchase: skips multipliers AND season accrual AND offline NoteEarnings AND vault skim (lines 72, 140-156)
flagSemantics.MultipliersApplied: skips multipliers ONLY; still accrues SeasonService.AddSeasonStat etc. (used by vault collect pads deliberately, VaultService.lua:1667-1672)
flagSemantics.HasTotal: also increments Total<Currency> in profile TotalStats (line 171-173)

addCurrency.rounding: NumberController.RoundNumber(Amount, 1) = math.round to whole number (CurrencyHandler.lua:102, NumberController.lua:15-20)
addCurrency.capsOrOverflowGuards: NONE. leaderstats '+=' on NumberValue doubles; no clamp, no int-limit guard. RemoveCurrency (line 181-206) has no floor - balances can go negative.
addCurrency.guardQuirk: If leaderstats or PlayerData is missing (join window), the grant is silently dropped (line 115-119).

multiplierSources.name: Pet Multi1
multiplierSources.magnitude: x(1 + sum of equipped pets' Multi1); pet Multi1 ranges 1..30 (x1.5 on golden-evolved)
multiplierSources.stacking: multiplicative vs other sources; additive across equipped pets

multiplierSources.name: 2x Cucumbers boost
multiplierSources.stacking: multiplicative with gamepass of same name (=> x4 together); durations stack additively

multiplierSources.name: Pet Multi2 (coin drops)
multiplierSources.magnitude: x(1 + sum equipped Multi2), applied OUTSIDE AddCurrency
multiplierSources.stacking: multiplies BonusCoins before AddCurrency, which then applies rebirth again

multiplierSources.name: Friend boost
multiplierSources.magnitude: +10% pickaxe damage per friend in server, cap 5 (x1.5)
multiplierSources.stacking: multiplies damage, not currency; excluded from time-skip/offline quotes

multiplierSources.name: Zone economy
multiplierSources.magnitude: reward x Orb x Multi per zone: Spawn 1x1 .. Narmek 7x6 (=42x)
multiplierSources.stacking: multiplies base before the personal stack

multiplierSources.name: Mutation / Prismatic / Lightning
multiplierSources.magnitude: mutation x25, PRISMATIC x100, lightning x(rolled bolt multiplier)

multiplierSources.name: Vault upgrade level
multiplierSources.magnitude: rate x 1.18^(level-1); FROZEN x0.8; golden x3, diamond x8, mutation x5/PRISMATIC x20, charged x4; biome tier x1.6^(tier-1)

gamepasses.name: 2x Cucumbers
gamepasses.detection: ProductController.CheckGamepassCached (hot path; pessimistic false until async check lands)

gamepasses.name: +4 Pet Slots
gamepasses.effect: +4 equipped-pet slots via Upgrades.SetPetEquips PassBonus -> more Multi1

products.name: Starter Pack
products.effect: 20,000 Coins flat (WasPurchase) + Red Demon pet; one-time, expiry burned on purchase

products.name: Time Skip 1 Minute
products.effect: grants Quote(rate*60) cucumbers flat; rate already fully multiplied

products.name: Vault Time Skips (6 durations)
products.effect: PLACEHOLDER ids - skipped by ProductHandler until dashboard products exist; would grant vault coins/sec x seconds

products.name: Nuke Server
products.effect: purchaser gets 100% damage credit for EVERY live breakable in server -> full multiplied cucumber payout for the entire field

boosts.magnitude: x2 cucumbers while remaining seconds > 0 (binary; magnitude never stacks)
boosts.durationStacking: additive: AddBoost adds seconds to remaining (BoostHandler.lua:68-85)
boosts.tick: Initialize loop decrements 1/sec per boost key while player online (BoostHandler.lua:88-108); time paused while offline
boosts.validateCrashRisk: ValidateBoosts does Boosts[BoostName] > 0 with no nil guard (BoostHandler.lua:58) - errors if the key is absent from the profile

offline.pays: Cucumbers (into OfflineData.Vault; claimed via ClaimVault -> AddCurrency WasPurchase flat, line 80-93)

tiers.window: next 10h away (until 6h of full-rate income is banked)

offline.rate: PET-ONLY rate (TimeSkipRateService.GetPetRate) checkpointed every 30s; includes ALL cucumber multipliers at checkpoint time (OfflineService.lua:54-70; TimeSkipRateService.lua:300-308)
offline.petInteraction: 0 income with no pets equipped (GetPetStrike returns 0, TimeSkipRateService.lua:230-241); pickaxe rate deliberately excluded 2026-08-22

playtimeQuirk: SESSION-ONLY ladder: timer and claim set reset on every rejoin (PlaytimeRewards.lua:9-13, 211-214) - free rebirth and both exclusive pets are re-earnable every session, indefinitely.
chestsNote: All payouts FLAT (WasPurchase, ChestHandler.lua:33-37); per-player cooldown persisted in profile.Chests; collection fires QuestChestCollected for the quest board.

season.xpSources: AddSeasonStat(Player, Currency, Amount) called from AddCurrency for every NON-WasPurchase grant of Cucumbers or Coins - i.e. post-multiplier earned amounts (CurrencyHandler.lua:140-144; SeasonService.lua:76-84)
season.incomeEffect: None directly; reward pets add Multi1/Multi2 when equipped.

streak.note: Coins on daily login, day 7 value repeats; missed day resets to day 1. Flat (WasPurchase). StreakService.lua:15, 31-45

otherGrants.name: Collection orbs

otherGrants.name: CUCUMBER SMASH podium
otherGrants.detail: winner: minigame spinner; runner-up: 5 min of own production, flat

otherGrants.name: Minigame reward spinner

otherGrants.name: Quest board claims

otherGrants.name: Sell all Cukes

otherGrants.name: Pet index milestones

otherGrants.name: Tutorial cuke top-up
otherGrants.detail: one-time grant up to cheapest vault upgrade cost, flat

stackingFormulas.Cucumbers: final = round(base x (1 + 0.5xRebirths) x (2 if 2xCukes gamepass) x Pets.Multi1 x (2 if 2xCukes boost active) x (1.5 if in group)) ; skipped when WasPurchase/MultipliersApplied
stackingFormulas.Coins: final = round(base x (1 + 0.5xRebirths)) ; Multi2 applies only pre-AddCurrency on direct Break() coin drops

Cucumbers.whaleCeiling: ~x45,000 realistic; ~x119,500 theoretical (26 x 2 x 766 [17 slots x golden 45] x 2 x 1.5)

Coins.range: x1..x26 (rebirths only) at AddCurrency; direct drops additionally x Multi2 (up to ~x287+)
